title: 赛诺菲拟410亿美元收购美国生物科技公司Insmed
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I mean, the CEO who came in recently, over the past year or so, had been very clear that the company is going to be doing M&A.
segments.zh: 新任CEO在过去一年明确表示公司将进行并购。

segments.en: Why? Because they have one drug, dopixant, which is first was developed for atopic dermatitis, eczema, but you know, obviously more serious versions of it.
segments.zh: 原因在于他们有一款药dopixant，最初用于特应性皮炎、湿疹，但显然还有更严重的适应症。

segments.en: And then also it's got applications for lung, asthma, COPD or these, you know, emphysema, et cetera.
segments.zh: 此外，它还适用于肺部、哮喘、慢阻肺或肺气肿等疾病。

segments.en: And if you look at the consensus and our own view of the drug, it's going to be half of the revenue, although it's not as much of the profits,
segments.zh: 根据市场共识和我们对该药的看法，它将贡献一半的收入，尽管利润占比没那么高，

segments.en: because it gives 50% of that back to the general. So they, you know, you don't want to leave a company to be that exposed.
segments.zh: 因为它将50%返还给general。所以，你不想让一家公司如此暴露。

segments.en: And also it's a product that, at some point, according to us later than what the patent actually says, the main patent, is going to go generic.
segments.zh: 而且该产品在某个时点，我们认为比专利实际声明的时间更晚，主要专利将面临仿制药竞争。

segments.en: So you need to fill that back up and eninsment is a pretty good fit here.
segments.zh: 因此需要填补这一缺口，而Insmed在这里非常合适。

segments.en: It's a respiratory business, mostly, a fist with the respiratory applications that they're in.
segments.zh: 它主要是一家呼吸业务公司，与他们所在的呼吸应用领域紧密契合。

segments.en: So it really fits very well. And it's exactly what the company needed.
segments.zh: 所以非常匹配，这正是公司所需要的。

segments.en: So when I was describing the valuation is demanding. The price being paid is demanding.
segments.zh: 所以当我描述估值时，我说要求很高。支付的价格要求很高。

segments.en: How would you describe it? Well, when you're a buyer that needs to buy, I think people can potentially ask for more.
segments.zh: 你会怎么描述？当买家必须买时，对方可能会要价更高。

segments.en: I'm not sure if it's demand. I mean, you know, they're going to just over four times, maybe a bit down in terms of debt multiple.
segments.zh: 我不确定这是不是需求。他们债务倍数将略超四倍，可能稍低。

segments.en: They're going to be generating 10, 11 billion euros of cash per year.
segments.zh: 他们每年将产生100到110亿欧元现金。

segments.en: So some of that will go to other uses, of course, CapEx and et cetera, et cetera, but it's operating pretty cash flow.
segments.zh: 部分资金当然会用于其他用途，如资本支出等，但这是经营现金流。
